action_summary: Created typed model and nine helper utility files to load CSV/JSON artifacts, parse and apply filters, and compute aggregations and histograms. Fixed import styles and lint issues, ensured type-only imports where appropriate, and ran lint/type-check/openapi checks.
implementation_notes:
- Used papaparse for CSV parsing with proper generics. - Avoided any/ts-ignore and used explicit types. - Implemented caching for file loads. - Adjusted imports to include .js extensions and type-only imports to satisfy tsconfig.
- Reworked filter parser to avoid unnecessary external zod dependency for runtime; used simple helpers to normalize inputs.
next_steps: If API routes are needed, implement routes that use these helpers (e.g., /api/cleaned, /api/attrition/aggregate).
Add unit tests for each helper to validate edge cases (empty files, missing columns).
